metadata.description: Go Vocal's internal plugin marketplace — the single source of truth for shared Claude skills.

plugins.name: govocal-coding
plugins.description: Prototype-building toolkit for vibecoded apps — UI primitives, accessibility, persona critique, translation, participation design. Maintained by Wietse, Jeroen, Irene and Rob.

plugins.name: govocal-paas
plugins.description: Participation-as-a-service delivery chain — Metabase conventions, project library, intake, project drafting, communication planning, strategic planning.

plugins.name: govocal-sales
plugins.description: Sales and bid toolkit — tender review, executive notes, competitor battlecards, intent signals.

plugins.name: govocal-gs
plugins.description: Government Success workflows — client account planning.

plugins.name: govocal-general
plugins.description: Company-wide basics — Go Vocal brand guidelines and the product expert.

plugins.name: govocal-management
plugins.description: Leadership & reporting toolkit — 1:1 follow-ups, CEO check-ins, revenues, LinkedIn content, weekly updates, misalignment radar, interesting-reads digest. Pushes to this plugin are confidentiality-gated.

plugins.name: govocal-reporting
plugins.description: Client reporting toolkit — /project-report generates a styled client-facing project report (PDF) from a platform's reporting MCP; draft recipes /resident-report (resident-facing cross-phase summary) and /platform-report (platform-level reach, inclusion & participation report). Benchmarks in marked test mode pending MCP expansion. Maintained by Irene.
